query:
UPDATE evolutionConversations ec
JOIN (
  SELECT em.conversationId, em.senderName
  FROM evolutionMessages em
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT conversationId, MAX(timestamp) as maxTs
    FROM evolutionMessages
    WHERE direction = 'inbound' AND senderName IS NOT NULL AND senderName != '' AND senderName != 'Vendedor'
    GROUP BY conversationId
  ) latest ON em.conversationId = latest.conversationId AND em.timestamp = latest.maxTs AND em.direction = 'inbound'
  WHERE em.senderName IS NOT NULL AND em.senderName != '' AND em.senderName != 'Vendedor'
) AS sender_info ON ec.id = sender_info.conversationId
SET ec.contactName = sender_info.senderName
WHERE ec.remoteJid LIKE '%@lid' AND (ec.contactName IS NULL OR ec.contactName = 'Vendedor' OR ec.contactName LIKE '%@lid');
